# DropSpace v0.2.0-preview.4

This Preview delivers the single-Dynamic-Island interface, final transparent branding, and the repaired official website/update metadata chain. The Smart drag detector was already confirmed working and is intentionally unchanged in this release.

Official website: https://airanluo-dot.github.io/DropSpace/

## One Dynamic Island

- Removes the former Notch visual mode completely, including its Settings selector, transition state, asymmetric top-edge region, and mode-specific geometry.
- Keeps Compact, Drop Ready, Expanded, Dismissing, full-screen restoration, Smart placement, and direct Explorer/Desktop drop on one continuously morphing rounded Dynamic Island.
- Migrates older settings safely by ignoring the removed display-mode field while preserving the user's other preferences.
- Does not change Smart drag recognition, the opt-in Classic top-edge compatibility mode, Disabled mode, OLE `CF_HDROP` validation, multi-display selection, or source-file safety.

## Final transparent brand

- Replaces every active legacy logo reference with the supplied true-alpha final PNG while preserving its original proportions, colors, structure, and surrounding glow.
- Regenerates the App EXE icon, taskbar/window icon, tray icon, installer and uninstaller, Start menu shortcuts, MSIX/Store/Share identity assets, README artwork, website header/footer/demo/download surfaces, favicon, and social preview image.
- Retains earlier generated brand assets only in an inactive provenance archive; they are not referenced by the running App, package, installer, or website.

## Official website and release API

- Fixes the live Stable indicator to one 7-pixel green dot followed by a normal horizontal API-updated description.
- Redesigns the former two-shape website section as **One Island. Ready for every drop.**, preserving the Compact, Drop Ready, and Expanded Dynamic Island demonstration.
- Makes GitHub Pages the single official website and versioned `/api/v1/releases.json` source. The App falls back to the official GitHub Releases API if website metadata is unavailable.
- Normalizes older release metadata during website builds so the retired Cloudflare URL cannot be reintroduced by a future release sync.

## Downloads and verification

- `DropSpaceSetup.exe` — recommended per-user installer with in-place Preview upgrade support.
- `DropSpace.exe` — portable self-contained x64 build.
- `DropSpace-x64.msix` — unsigned alternative package.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` and `update-manifest.json` — integrity and in-app update metadata.

This Preview is unsigned, so Windows Defender SmartScreen may show an unknown-app warning. Download only from this official GitHub Release and verify the SHA-256 values. Stable-channel users remain on v0.1.0; select the Preview channel to receive v0.2.0-preview.4.
